content.short: Polytrade Finance is a lending protocol on 0xPolygon, bringing real-world asset yields to DeFi.
content.description: Polytrade Finance is a multi-chain lending protocol that delivers real-world asset yields to DeFi. Spanning Polygon, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, OP Mainnet and Base, its four core products bring real-world finance into Web3 through advanced DeFi and fintech capabilities. The first use case, trade finance, is built on the protocol’s underwriting engine and has established the first global on-chain Proof of Trade (PoT). This PoT framework provides verifiable, on-chain evidence of trade activity.
